items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I remember everyone of us, we went over to a costume building where all the clothes for the movie stars were stored away until they need them. So they fitted me -- I was so big that they fitted me with tuxedo tails and right on the inside of the lapels it says, 'Sidney Greenstreet.' I'll never forge

ctx.x: that big band that he had in the mid-40s, he recorded in 1946 and you were involved in that recording for the RCA Victor Company, Victor Records.

Those records were the tunes out of the picture "New Orleans," you know what year that was made -- it was made in New Orleans. That was a wonderful experience, too, when we were in Hollywood in those studios. And one time one of the trumpet players who always loved brown shoes, so instead of wearing black shoes -- we were having tails and dark suits with tails and I remember everyone of us, we went over to a costume building where all the clothes for the movie stars were stored away until they need them.
